items.headline: OpenAI prepares next security sprint with Cathedral Systems
items.summary: OpenAI is preparing its next internal security sprint in partnership with Cathedral Systems. The initiative aims to test and strengthen the organisation's defences using AI.
items.why_it_matters: The security sprint aims to test and enhance OpenAI's internal defences.
items.evidence_quote: OpenAI is preparing its next internal security sprint with Cathedral Systems to test and strengthen its defenses using AI.

items.headline: OpenAI increases rewards for security bug bounties
items.summary: OpenAI is increasing its Security Bug Bounty rewards for independent security researchers. The company is also introducing bonuses for report quality, loyalty, and priority campaigns.
items.why_it_matters: Independent researchers will receive higher rewards and bonuses for finding security vulnerabilities.
items.evidence_quote: OpenAI is raising Security Bug Bounty rewards and introducing report quality, loyalty, and priority campaign bonuses for independent security researchers.

items.headline: Cities implement Nvidia physical and agentic AI for public services
items.summary: Local governments worldwide are using Nvidia physical and agentic AI to process municipal data from cameras and sensors. The technology powers infrastructure planning digital twins and service agents.
items.why_it_matters: Municipalities are adopting physical and agentic AI to manage urban infrastructure and operations.
items.evidence_quote: Cities Worldwide Build and Scale AI Services With NVIDIA Physical and Agentic AI

items.headline: Anthropic restricts Claude Code from cloning existing video games
items.summary: Anthropic has modified Claude Code's system prompt to stop the AI tool from recreating existing video games. Users are still permitted to build original games with the software.
items.why_it_matters: Developers can no longer use Claude Code to re-create existing video games.
items.evidence_quote: Anthropic has updated Claude Code's system prompt to prevent the AI tool from being used to re-create existing video games
